# Production

## Inputs

Approved anchor, exact slide copy, brand assets, assigned references, and per-slide prompts.

## Process

Generate one slide at a time from the approved anchor. Apply production copy with a deterministic text layer. Inspect each result at full size and 320 pixels wide before continuing. Reject undersized or changed fonts, text crowding, glow behind text, low contrast, added symbols, redundant copy, crop risks, identity drift, repeated visuals, and false details. Fix only the failed slide before continuing.

## Outputs

Separate ordered slide files plus complete prompt records. Save visual QA notes too.

## Human check

Review the complete ordered carousel at thumbnail and full size before release packaging.
